_readme: Editor's picks for /black-friday-ads and /christmas-ads. Each pick needs the Meta ad ID (the number after ?id= in an Ad Library link) and a one-line reason. Brand and copy are filled in from the season archive automatically; pageName/pageId here are only a fallback. Order is the display order. Keep it to about 6-12 per event.

black-friday.reason: Turns the sale into a prize draw (a trip to Barbados), so it stands out in a feed full of percentage-off ads.
Creator-led and tackles the biggest Black Friday doubt head on: a price guarantee until Christmas.
Builds a VIP list before the sale with a specific date, time and hero product. A low-cost way to own the first day.
Gives a standard trial discount a voice of its own, and is upfront about the subscription terms.
Offers a free gift instead of a discount, which protects margin, and makes it a one-day deadline.
Started three weeks before Black Friday and is still running. The offer is backed by reviews and a 365-day guarantee.

christmas.reason: The big brand story of the season, cut for social with a clear 'watch the full ad' hook.
A cheeky one-liner ('Santa's credit card is shaking') that makes an electricals retailer feel festive.
Sells a moment with friends rather than a product. Warm, simple and very on-brand for a discounter.
A charity shop that has run all season, framing gifts as 'gifts that mean more'.
Flips a famous line ('a dog is for life') to sell real trees. Memorable copy from a small advertiser.
A niche product that has run for a month with a simple festive twist on its usual message.
